caption: The drawing depicts a single, large ceramic jug or crock with two small handles on either side, set against a plain beige or tan background. The jug is grayish-beige in color with a slightly reflective surface, indicating a glazed texture. Blue decorative elements, including swirls, loops, and dots, encircle the upper half of the jug. Toward the bottom front of the jug, the number "1842" is written prominently in blue, along with additional blue ornamental lines and curls above it. The rim of the jug is darker, suggesting a shadowed interior. The jug is centered in the composition, and there are no other objects present in the drawing.
title: Butter Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
